summary: ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report that it regained compliance with Nasdaq's Minimum Stockholders Equity Requirement of $2.5 million after a hearing on May 28, 2026. The Nasdaq Staff issued written notice on July 8, 2026, confirming compliance. The company will be subject to a one-year Discretionary Panel Monitor, during which any future non-compliance may result in delisting without an opportunity to cure. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special-situation corporate event.
